Androstenedione, through its interaction with the Gamma-aminobutyric acid type B receptor subunit 1, may influence cellular signaling pathways. This chain of interactions implies a possible regulatory mechanism where Hydrocortisone indirectly affects the receptor through androstenedione. The evidence is supported by a high confidence score, indicating a plausible biological connection. However, the exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the role of Hydrocortisone in modulating this receptor.
